decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times (10am-11pm).

Condition : 4 - The proposed change of use to the ground floor of Marion House from B1 (offices) to A3 (restaurant) would not be detrimental to the overall availability of office space within Hounslow, it would positively contribute to the vitality of the area, and would not harm the amenity or appearance of the area in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies T.1.4, ENV-B1.1 and E.1.5.
description: Change of use of ground floor from B1 offices to A3 Restaurant
